name: Pack 6: drum racks
words: The analog drum machine’s five kits each as one drum rack, every drum on its own pad (for the DAW’s drum rack tracks); pack 4’s grooves.

sounds.name: Analog 808 rack
sounds.words: The analog drum machine the 808 as its circuits behave, every drum on its own pad: kick, hats and cymbals, snare, clap, toms and logs, wood, rim, clave, cowbell, shaker.

sounds.name: Analog 909 rack
sounds.words: The analog drum machine the 909 as its circuits behave, every drum on its own pad: kick, hats and cymbals, snare, clap, toms and logs, wood, rim, clave, cowbell, shaker.

sounds.name: Analog Deep rack
sounds.words: The analog drum machine deep and round, every drum on its own pad: kick, hats and cymbals, snare, clap, toms and logs, wood, rim, clave, cowbell, shaker.

sounds.name: Analog Warm rack
sounds.words: The analog drum machine through warm tape, every drum on its own pad: kick, hats and cymbals, snare, clap, toms and logs, wood, rim, clave, cowbell, shaker.

sounds.name: Analog Grit rack
sounds.words: The analog drum machine driven hard, every drum on its own pad: kick, hats and cymbals, snare, clap, toms and logs, wood, rim, clave, cowbell, shaker.

harmonies.words: One chord, low and heavy (you chose it twice).

harmonies.words: One plain chord: the movement all in the rhythm.

harmonies.name: A pedal, the top moving
harmonies.words: A minor 7, sus4, minor 9 over the same A.

harmonies.words: E minor 7, then F major 7, 8 bars each.
